title: Resolve the offline fixture dependency explicitly
goal: Install only the two approved fixture identities using explicit local files and a checked DNF plan.
challenge: Reject the named unsupported helper operation unapproved and retain its specific refusal. Review and apply only the compatible pair from the fixed helper; verify actual installed identities/versions and the exact unprivileged report. Compare unrelated package state and perform exact cleanup. This is not arbitrary DNF solver or repository practice.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-dnf-transaction.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-dnf-transaction.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here && fresh "$w/unapproved-operation.txt" || return 19; if sudo "$h" preview unapproved > unapproved-operation.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F "Supported operations:" unapproved-operation.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: The helper rejects an unsupported operation before application. This is not the developer-only resolved foreign-package test.
steps.expected: Explicit operation refusal, unchanged fixture state.

steps.explanation: Inspect names, versions, architectures and actions. File names and --no-download alone do not bound solver effects.
Type APPLY only after reviewing the displayed plan; another answer cancels. One DNF transaction object is validated and applied.
steps.expected: Exact pair installed without unrelated changes or downloads.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/report.txt" && fresh "$w/expected-report.txt" && rpm -q ll-rpm-data ll-rpm-report && /usr/bin/ll-rpm-report > report.txt && printf "%s\n" "Learning Lab package report" header=inventory-2.0 "Learning Lab offline inventory" fixture_data_version=2.0 items=3 > expected-report.txt && cmp expected-report.txt report.txt && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt)" = root:root:644:1 && cat report.txt
steps.explanation: Verify actual unprivileged execution, full expected bytes and payload ownership. A solver exit status is insufficient.
steps.expected: Data 2.0/report 1.0, exactly the expected report readable by learner.

hints: No-download/repo disabling alone is not a boundary; unprivileged preview need not match privileged execution.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 DNF awareness/dependency frontend; modern YUM compatibility limitation. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
